nom: PÜR Minerals Sea Fresh Purifying Gel Foam Cleanser

avis.texte: Yep. This is a good one. Only problem - I put it on the shower top ledge and it fell. That's when I realized it's actually a Glass Bottle. Don't be like me 😂.
This is my favorite facial cleanser! It is gentle, energizing and soothing. It foams very well and rinses clean. Try it, you won't regret it!
Finally found a product that is good for my oily skin type! Hope Ultra continues Pur products online cause they have become unavailable in my store location!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: Excellent cleanser, gentle and great cleaner. Leaves my face feeling clean and refreshed.

This is a fresh cleanser thar removes make up well. The scent reminds me of Aveda products. The ingredients include pepermint oil which some people dont tolerate well. But I had no issue and I do have sensitive skin.

Didnt really do much to my face, if anything i did break out around my cheeks a bit. I have oily skin and the minty scent probably triggered the acne. I wanted to really wanted to like it but my face doesnt even feel truly cleaned.

avis.titre: Not for someone with oily skin
avis.texte: Oily combo skin here, and I have to say it doesn't work for me. Especially with the mint scent that causes irritation to my skin. Having almost completed the bottle trying to give it a chance and my skin has only become worse because of it. Tonight finally went back to my old face wash and immediately felt the difference in the cleaning of oils it does as this face wash always left me felling a little oily no matter how much soap I used.

Normally I use Kate Somerville Eradicate, but I needed a new cleanser & didn't have the funds for KS & this was on sale.... I fell in love 💞. I love the way it cleanses completely without stripping my face, and it feels like going to the spa. The scent is very fresh with a hint of mint. A tiny bit goes a long way! Do not drop the bottle; it can & will break 💔. I'm on my third bottle; it keeps my skin soft, and radiant. I use it in the shower and take the excess down my neck and chest/shoulders. This is a "Yes Please 🥺"!

avis.titre: Love how fresh this leaves my skin!
avis.texte: One of my favorite cleansers for freshness! Feels like spending all day at the beach and then taking a shower! So refreshing!

avis.titre: This Cleanser will definitely become my Go-To!
avis.texte: I have extremely sensitive skin, not to mention oily, especially in my Tzone. I always apply cleansers and moisturizers twice a day, usually morning and night! This cleanser is truly amazing. If you are one for scents, this is a must-have! Refreshing, not stripping, and clearly hydrating! Even after one use, you can feel the difference in texture of your skin! Can't wait to see the drastic difference applying this every day! xo

This face wash did not work for my skin type . I have dry/combination and VERY sensitive skin. It broke me out all along my chin and neck. I haven't had ache in years. 2 hours after using it my face felt really dirty and greasy. The rashes were accompanied by small bumps all over my face and neck. I think if I washed my face with WATER I would have been better off. If you have sensitive skin STAY FAR AWAY.

avis.titre: Amazing for daily skin care routine
avis.texte: This product made my skin feel so clean! It's an amazing way to complete my daily skin care routine! And the fragrance is wonderful!
I'm in love with this facial cleanser! From the amazing lather to the clean and refreshing feel it provides. My skin appears to be glowing after I use it...LOVE, LOVE, LOVE!
Wow! This cleanser is so refreshing on my skin. Feel so clean and the minty smell is such an added bonus. My skin feels so amazing after using!

I really love this cleanser! It makes my skin feel super hydrated and soft after use, rather than stripped and dry like other cleansers tend to do. The mint scent is also really nice. It is invigorating and really wakes me up when I wash my face in the morning.

This product is awesome! I have very sensitive skin, and this is one of the few cleansers where I feel it gets the job done without irritating or stripping my skin. I love the texture of it and the scent is so refreshing. I have no complaints. Also- let's talk about how fabulous the packaging is that the pump locks so it makes it easier to travel with!

i used to love the see no more cleanser, but this is my new go-to. it's great for sensitive skin, leaves the skin feeling clean and radiant without stripping the natural oils. this + the rescue c moisturizer is my new holy grail:pray:
Great for sensitive skin feels cool and refreshing removes make up and skin is glowing.
This product was recommended by Good Housekeeping in the most recent magazine. I've always liked the products they tested and they agree with other reviewers

avis.titre: PR Beauty Sea Fresh Purifying Gel Foam Cleanser
avis.texte: Absolutely loved this face soap. My face feels so clean and healthy after using. The scent is really nice also!

I absolutely love this cleanser - from the way it smells, to the way it makes my skin feel during the application and afterwards. I feel like I'm at the spa! If you're thinking about getting this, definitely do - I'm so glad I did!
The wash made my face feel so clean and refreshing! I tingles made my face feel so fresh!
Love the way my skin feels after using and the scent is so good and calming

I am a cleanser connoisseur and this is my new FAVORITE cleanser. It smells amazing, it has a rich luxurious lather and my skin feels clean and hydrated after cleansing. It is not dry and stripping like some i have tried in the past. If you are looking for a new cleanser, look no further... give it a go, you will be pleased.
